name: bogura-kothon-platform
description: Production-ready multilingual newsroom platform for Bogura Kothon

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace admin-dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace admin-dashboard
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace frontend && npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace admin-dashboard
